# Test fixtures

- `snore.wav`: fake microphone feed for the browser tests (see `gen-audio.mjs`).
- `psg-snore-room.wav`: 30 s of real snoring heard by a room microphone about 1 m
  above the bed, from PSG-Audio patient 00001250, hour 2, 288-318 s (technician-scored
  Snore events at 290.5 s and 314.5 s). Korompili et al., *Scientific Data* 2021,
  doi:10.11922/sciencedb.00345, CC BY 4.0. Used by `test-listening.mjs`.
